about_short_description.short_description: The Operating System for Hotels and Vacation Rentals

product.name: Stayflexi Autonomous PMS
product.description: A property management system designed for hotels and vacation rentals that automates front desk operations including room allocation, check-in, and check-out processes.

product.name: Stayflexi Channel Manager
product.description: A channel management tool that synchronizes room inventory and bookings across over 100 online travel agencies to prevent overbookings and discrepancies.

product.name: Stayflexi Booking Engine
product.description: An online booking system with an OTA-like interface that enables direct bookings, flexible check-in/out times, and upselling of add-on services.

product.name: Stayflexi Revenue Manager
product.description: A revenue management system that automates pricing strategies and provides competitive rate shopping to optimize room rates and increase bookings.

product.name: Stayflexi Magic Link
product.description: A web-based guest engagement tool that enables app-free self check-in, room upgrades, in-room service orders, and booking lifecycle management via a single link.

product.name: Stayflexi Guest Messaging
product.description: A unified messaging platform that consolidates guest communications into one inbox for instant engagement and upselling opportunities.
